messages:
Ana: Quick checkwe need to finalize topic + logistics for the May webinar. Proposed title: "Production LLM Serving Patterns". Items: final title, speaker order, rehearsal time, captioning, and lead routing. Prefer 9am PT / 12pm ET for live. Thoughts?
Mike: 9am PT is fine. Good for EMEA folks to catch the tail end.
Sylvia: I'll own captions + post-webinar transcript. Recommend Otter for auto + one person QC. Need a consent slide.
Jenna: I'm in for ops/runtime talk. Will need a mic check and 30m in rehearsal for demo smoke test.
Priya: I'll do the customer ROI piece. Can add two bullets on cost per request reduction.
Tom: Benchmarks segment OK. I'll prepare a single visual comparing quantized vs fp16 latency.
Sam: Reminder: upload final deck to /marketing/webinars/production-llm/ by Tue EOD. Also add a 90s pre-recorded demo clip into /marketing/webinars/production-llm/assets for fallback.
Devon: Routing: enterprise leads -> ae-enterprise; demo requests -> webinar-sdr. Use utm=prod-llm-may. Example webhook payload we will use: ```{ "utm_campaign": "prod-llm-may", "source": "webinar", "tags": ["webinar","prod-llm"], "route": "ae-enterprise" }```
Ana: Proposed rehearsal windows: Wed 11am PT or Thu 4pm PT. Jenna prefers Wed 11am PT. Anyone need Thu instead?
Jenna: Wed 11am PT confirmed. I want 20m for slides + 15m demo smoke test.
Mike: I'll draft two promo lines and the social copy. Target send Wed morning for initial invite.
Sylvia: Caption workflow: Otter -> VTT export -> manual QC by Sylvia -> attach to recording. Aim to publish transcript next day.
Devon: I'll wire the webhook mapping into sales ops and tag the lead records with prod-llm-may.
Priya: Can @Sam drop the customer PV numbers into the slide before Tue EOD? I need them for ROI bullets.
Sam: Yep adding PV numbers and uploading demo assets today. Also adding a short moderator fallback script.
zoom-bot: Meeting created: "Production LLM Serving Patterns - Rehearsal" Wed 11:00 PT. Invites sent.
Ana: Great  locking: live 12pm ET (9am PT), rehearsal Wed 11am PT, deck due Tue EOD, captions Otter+QC, utm prod-llm-may, routing as Devon listed. I'll post the run-of-show shortly. Thanks!
